title: Thai-Style Hashed Noodles
description: A quick and easy Thai-inspired dish made with hashed chicken and noodles.
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions.
Heat the quick fix sauce in a pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper to the pan and cook until they are softened.
Add the diced chicken to the pan and cook until it is browned and cooked through.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and stir to combine.
Stir in the chopped Thai basil.
Serve the dish hot, garnished with hash if desired.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
